changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO "user".users (email, password_hash, full_name, position, branch_id, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT 'admin-' || b.code || '@remark.local', '$2a$10$cWBw.zR6J8KsATHCyG1BdudJd/Yk/IQdLMJiV3QpuohmHQH2bo.1G', 'Администратор ' || b.name, 'Администратор', b.id, 'ACTIVE', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM ref.branches b WHERE b.active = true;
INSERT INTO "user".user_roles (user_id, role_id) SELECT u.id, r.id FROM "user".users u JOIN "user".roles r ON r.code = 'ADMIN' WHERE u.email LIKE 'admin-%@remark.local';
